answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 162921 Country: India Title: Namaz-e-qasar Question: I want to know that as I am appointed in Kotdwara, about 100 Km from my hometown Roorkee, and I used to up-down daily so I travel about 200 Km per day. What Namaz should I offer during my travel, Full namaz or Namaz-e-Qasar? What Namaz Should I offer when in Kotdwara? What Namaz when in a middle station? Answer ID: 162921 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1198/1078/M=9/1439) If Roorkee is your native place and you go Kotdwara everyday covering 100 km distance from your native place and return from there daily, then you will be musafir when you will leave Roorkee and in Kotdwara till you return to your native place and will offer qasr salah and when you will enter your native place Roorkee you would turn muqim. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
